subject: AWS Marketplace listing — hero, pricing clarity, and demo playbook
messages:
From: Grace Thompson <grace@acme-analytics.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: AWS listing details we need for launch

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We want to move quickly on the AWS listing and co-sell collateral. To finalize our internal review we need:

- Final hero heading and short blurb (50–80 chars / 1–2 lines)
- A clear one-line pricing summary for the product page and a link to the detailed pricing terms
- A short demo playbook we can share with our field (3–4 bullets + 1 sample script)

Can you send over the proposed copy and any visual mocks? Procurement may also want the SKU names for entitlement mapping.

Best,
Grace
Lead Product Partnerships
Acme Analytics

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Grace Thompson <grace@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing details we need for launch

Grace —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Attached are three artifacts to get us over the finish line: hero_variants_v3.png (three hero copy + visual treatments), pricing-terms-table.xlsx (SKU-level pricing and private offer notes), and demo-playbook-v1.pdf (short playbook + sample script). Highlights below.

Hero (short):
- Option A (recommended): "Production-grade LLM inference — predictable latency, lower unit cost"
- Option B (concise): "Fast, reliable LLM serving for production apps"

Blurb (30–60 words):
- "Redwood Inference delivers a unified runtime for serving LLMs with predictable latency, configurable cost controls, and seamless deployment across hosted, dedicated, and private modes. Ship features faster while keeping inference economics under control."

Pricing one-liner:
- "Usage-based pricing with optional reserved capacity; see SKU table for commit tiers and burst pricing."

Demo playbook (3 bullets + sample opener):
- Pain: Show dashboard token-cost and latency variance for a customer use case
- Solution: Walk through model selection + autoscaling policy in Console (3 min)
- Close: Run a short live query and show trace + cost per 1k tokens

Sample opener script: "Hi — today I’ll show how Redwood reduces token costs by 30% on typical chat workloads while keeping p95 latency under 250ms."

Notes:
- Kimberly: see the hero mockups and visual spacing concerns on variant C (feedback inline).
- Marcus: the pricing sheet includes a private-offer SKU we discussed; procurement will want the entitlement keys.

If this looks good, Grace — can we lock Option A for the marketplace hero and push the variant images to AWS assets? We can hand off the SKU list and a small field one-pager for co-sell enablement.

Thanks,
Mina
Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
(attachment: hero_variants_v3.png image)
(attachment: pricing-terms-table.xlsx spreadsheet)
(attachment: demo-playbook-v1.pdf pdf)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing details we need for launch

Quick design thoughts after reviewing hero_variants_v3:

- Variant A copy pushes a lot of claims into the heading; recommend we keep heading tighter and move capability calls to the blurb. Heading suggestion: "Predictable LLM inference for production" (44 chars).
- Variant B visual uses a product screenshot that will need a tighter crop for AWS thumbnail sizes (16:9 and 4:3). I added crop notes on the file.
- We should confirm whether AWS allows the phrase "lower unit cost" in the hero copy — legal flagged similar comparative claims previously.

Also, pricing-terms-table: the private-offer SKU names look fine, but we should change the visible marketplace SKU to read: RW-INF-PRO-1 (keeps it short for search).

I'll sync with design on image exports after copy is locked.

- Kimberly
Director, Designer Experience
(attachment: hero_variants_v3.png [annotated])

From: Grace Thompson <grace@acme-analytics.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-11-10T09:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing details we need for launch

Thanks, Mina & Kimberly — this is helpful. A couple quick asks from our side:

1) Can we get the 1-line pricing copy to explicitly state whether trial usage is billable? Our field wants clarity for demos.
2) Procurement asked for the formal entitlement keys and a brief note on data residency (we're US-only).

Minor tweak request on hero: they prefer the phrase "production-grade" in the heading if possible. Could you share the cropped 16:9 hero for the marketplace preview?

If you send the revised hero and a one-paragraph statement on data residency, we can finalize internal approvals and pass to AWS for listing submission.

Best,
Grace

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Grace Thompson <grace@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-11T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing details we need for launch

Grace — quick update and attachments per your asks.

- Trial billing: Short copy for page: "Free trial available for new accounts; trial usage is billable after free credits are exhausted — see SKU table for thresholds." Full terms included in pricing-terms-table.xlsx.
- Data residency: "Redwood can be deployed in US regions only for this listing; customer data processed in-region and logs retained per configured retention policies. We support KMS integrations for customer-managed keys." (legal approved).
- Attached: hero_16x9_cropped.png (export), updated pricing-terms-table.xlsx (row highlighted for free-credit thresholds), and entitlement_keys.txt (SKU -> entitlement mapping).

Next steps: Marcus will create the HubSpot listing (ACME-2026-019) and I’ll hand off the AWS package (copy + images + SKU file). Kimberly will export final hero images for AWS dimensions.

Thanks — I’ll ping once the HubSpot record is live and the DocuSign for the private-offer is routed.

Mina
Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
(attachment: hero_16x9_cropped.png image)
(attachment: entitlement_keys.txt text)
Notes: These messages preserve quoted replies and attachment stubs. All internal participants are team members in the sources/gmail directory.
